name: FX_Splode

textures.channels: RGB straight colour (sRGB) + alpha; 4 x 4 frames of 512 px, row by row from the top left

flipbook.ground_line: the sprite's ground point is 5 % of the frame above its bottom edge; side view at 18 degrees

source_note: frames are computed by the build script (seeded, deterministic): numpy fields -> OpenVDB -> Cycles volume render; no .blend is kept
dresses: explosion 70, 0.6 s: a ragged fireball growing to 2.1 m, white-hot, cooling to pale grey smoke with sooty edges that opens into a ring of soot
known_weaknesses: Analytic shape and noise, not a simulation; no sparks or debris, no light on the scene. A flipbook on a camera-facing card: it has no depth against the scene and casts no light.
